problem: BeBee needs one primary pollination ownership rule before permanent FlowerPatch production: it must remain low-friction on touch, avoid passive waiting, preserve deliberate cause/effect and make controlling the bee matter over repeated interactions.

decision.rationale: The controlled A/B/C browser experiment completed all three fixed patches in every mode. Auto spent 38.1% of the scripted run stationary inside patches. Hold spent 33.1% stationary, required three explicit holds and adds a 108x108 second touch control. Sweep had zero stationary progress and no separate pollination button while completing the same field; its roughly 32.6% extra movement is aligned with the bee-flight fantasy but requires P2 tuning so natural passes work without micro-circling.

selected_references.name: Cow Bay explicit action
selected_references.selection_reason: Provides a minimal explicit-action comparison for Hold.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Poki documents tap/click on objects as the harvest/use action.
selected_references.inference: Explicit intent is clear, but a separate repeated action may be unnecessary if bee movement can own pollination.

selected_references.name: Dreamdale proximity harvesting
selected_references.selection_reason: Closest reference for progress caused by proximity/standing near resources.
selected_references.observed_behavior: The mechanics reference describes some harvesting by standing near/walking over resources without idle tapping.
selected_references.inference: Low input cost can create passive waiting; BB-P003 measures stationary time directly.

selected_references.name: My Little Universe manual controls
selected_references.selection_reason: Shows a shipped automatic/manual ownership contrast rather than assuming either is universally best.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Xbox Wire describes Manual Controls where chopping/mining actions require button presses.
selected_references.inference: Ownership can change feel, but BeBee can get ownership from movement rather than another action button.

anti_pattern.observation: Forager combines movement with a separate explicit resource-hit input.
anti_pattern.lesson: Strong action ownership does not require BeBee to import an attack/tool input; adding a second high-frequency channel should have evidence that movement alone cannot solve the problem.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Pointer Events provide a hardware-agnostic mouse/pen/touch input model and pointer capture can retain an active pointer during a drag; the disposable lab uses this for its touch movement/action boundary.

official_docs_exception: Production Defold input implementation is intentionally not selected by this browser experiment and must be researched against current Defold input documentation in P0/P1.

alternatives.reason: Lowest explicit input cost, but controlled browser evidence reproduced substantial stationary progress (6.1s / 38.1% of run) and the intrinsic rule continues while standing still.
Explicit intent, but still allows stationary completion, required three holds in the three-patch run, and adds a second 108x108 touch control occupying about 4.95% of the rendered canvas area.

Zero stationary progress, no separate pollination button and direct alignment between the required movement control and pollination progress; exact work-distance tuning remains open to prevent micro-circling.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All three variants complete the same three fixed patches under real browser input without runtime/browser errors.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: evidence/BB-P003/browser-run-2026-08-28.json records 3/3 completion for Auto, Hold and Sweep and browser_errors=[].

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Stationary waiting and extra action cost are measured rather than inferred.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Browser run records stationary share 38.1% Auto, 33.1% Hold, 0.0% Sweep; Hold records 3 pollination holds while Auto/Sweep record 0.
640x820 touch-layout measurement records common 120x120 movement stick and Hold-only 108x108 POLLINATE control; raw control overlay area is 11.06% Hold vs 6.11% Auto/Sweep.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The selected decision does not incorrectly lock disposable pixel-distance balance.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: D-006 and result research validate movement-owned sweep semantics while explicitly keeping exact movement/work target and accidental fly-through threshold tunable for P2.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A separate evaluation identifies the main downside of the winner instead of reporting only confirming evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/research/BB-P003-pollination-result.md records Sweep's ~32.6% extra movement and micro-circling/incidental-progress risks and issues PASS WITH DEVIATION.

automated: Browser run used Python Playwright with real Arrow/Space events and rendered-canvas bee-position observation; no module state was directly mutated during the measured desktop completion runs.
manual: Inspected final rendered desktop captures for all three complete states and touch layouts; verified Hold adds a second large touch action while Auto/Sweep do not.
Separate evaluator pass reviewed the original problem, pre-implementation references, measured run data and rendered captures before selecting Sweep.
verification.runtime_errors: none observed in measured Chromium run
verification.save_data_impact: none; product decision/prototype evidence only, no production persistence exists

experiment_results.validated_scope: movement-owned progress while inside patch; no stationary progress; no mandatory separate pollination button

governance.trust_boundary_change: Updates authoritative D-006 from HYPOTHESIS proximity-auto to VALIDATED movement-through/sweep based on direct experiment evidence. It does not change CI policy, required checks, reviewer requirements or candidate/base authority.
governance.bypass_analysis: The change does not classify runtime gameplay code as process: no production runtime is changed. The source-of-truth update carries same-PR evidence, measured counterevidence for rejected variants and a bounded validation scope instead of using the governance class to skip the experiment.
governance.rollback: If P2 production evidence shows movement-owned sweep cannot meet touch/repetition requirements without micro-circling, revert D-006 to HYPOTHESIS and reopen A/B/hybrid comparison using the retained experiment report; no production save migration is involved.

known_limitations: The scripted browser pilot is not a human comfort playtest; evidence strength is MEDIUM rather than HIGH.
Local P-1 screenshots were inspected and hashed but the exact-build CI artifact-retention system does not exist until P0; the manifest does not falsely claim retained CI visual artifacts.
Small completion-time differences include controller/navigation overhead and are not used as production balance targets.
